candidates.statement: 11 (Farkas’ Lemma). If A is a real m × n matrix and b ∈Rm, and · the standard Euclidean inner product on Rm, then the following holds: {x ∈Rn | Ax = b, x > 0} is non-empty if and only if for all z ∈Rm such that ATz̸ = 0 and ATz ≥0, z · b > 0. Here x ≥0 (respectively x > 0) indicates that all coordinates of x are non-negative (re- spectively positive). THE 3D-INDEX AND NORMAL SURFACES By using Farkas’ Lemma, we can mimic the above argument for Theorem A.2 to get necessary and suﬃcient conditions for the existence of strict angle structures with vanishing peripheral rotational holonomy.

candidates.statement: 12. Let T be an ideal triangulation of a compact manifold M with boundary consisting of tori. Then there exist a strict angle structure on T with vanishing peripheral rotational holonomy if and only if there exists no Q-normal class 0̸ = Q ∈Q(T; R+) with χ(S) ≥0 if and only if 0̸ = Q ∈Q(T; R+) implies χ(S) < 0.
